name: Museum Tour Guide
place: A history and art museum lobby
role: You are an expert museum guide.
speaker: Guide

tasks.goal: Greet the guide and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the guide and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about guided tour start times and ticket meeting point
tasks.hint: Ask where and when the next tour begins.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tour start time and meeting point.

tasks.goal: Ask about main historical highlights covered in the exhibition
tasks.hint: Inquire which major artifacts are included.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about key museum exhibits.

tasks.goal: Ask if photography without flash is permitted in art galleries
tasks.hint: Inquire about museum photography rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about photography rules in galleries.
tasks.scene_hint: Footsteps echo softly on marble floors under cavernous vaulted ceilings.

tasks.goal: Ask about total duration of the guided walkthrough tour
tasks.hint: Inquire how long the tour lasts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about guided tour duration.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'exhibit'
tasks.hint: Exhibit is a displayed item. Ask where the ancient artifact exhibit is.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'exhibit'.

tasks.goal: Request details about artist background for a featured sculpture
tasks.hint: Ask the guide for historical background on a work.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about artist history or sculpture background.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification on historical timeline details during lecture
tasks.hint: Request deeper historical context on a date.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for clarification on historical dates or events.

tasks.goal: Inquire if audio headset guides are available in foreign languages
tasks.hint: Ask about multilingual audio rental.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about audio guide availability.

tasks.goal: Ask how to navigate back after getting separated from tour group
tasks.hint: Respond after lagging behind during exhibit transition.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked guide how to re-join tour group.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft spotlight illuminates an ancient gold crown inside a glass case.

tasks.goal: Ask if wheelchair accessible ramps connect upper gallery floors
tasks.hint: Inquire about accessibility elevators.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about elevator or wheelchair accessibility.

tasks.goal: Confirm museum closing hours and exit locations
tasks.hint: Verify when museum doors close.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed museum closing time.

tasks.goal: Inquire about museum gift shop location and replica items
tasks.hint: Ask where to purchase exhibition books and gifts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gift shop location.

tasks.goal: Ask if tour ticket includes entry to temporary special exhibits
tasks.hint: Verify if ticket covers extra gallery rooms.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified ticket coverage for special exhibits.

tasks.goal: Thank the guide and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the guide AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about guided tour ticket availability for today's afternoon schedule
tasks.hint: Ask guide if tickets remain for the 2 PM tour.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tour ticket availability.

tasks.goal: Express interest in the museum's ancient Egyptian artifact collection
tasks.hint: State your enthusiasm for viewing ancient historical exhibits.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed interest in ancient Egyptian artifacts.

tasks.goal: Ask where the guided group gathers before tour departure
tasks.hint: Inquire about the designated assembly location.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where the tour group meets.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'artifact'
tasks.hint: Artifact is a historical object. Inquire about the origin of a displayed ancient artifact.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'artifact'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'provenance'
tasks.hint: Provenance refers to the ownership history of artwork. Ask the guide about the provenance of a master painting.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'provenance'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'display'
tasks.hint: A display is a public showing of objects or artwork. Ask about the seasonal artifact display in the main gallery.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'display'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'antiquity'
tasks.hint: Antiquity refers to ancient times. Discuss the preservation of artifacts from classical antiquity.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'antiquity'.

tasks.goal: Ask the guide to explain the historical context of a medieval tapestry
tasks.hint: Inquire about the political and cultural background of the textile artwork.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about medieval tapestry historical context.

tasks.goal: Discuss recent restoration techniques used on Renaissance oil paintings
tasks.hint: Inquire how conservators repair aging canvas and pigments.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed painting restoration techniques.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the symbolic meaning of architectural motifs on display
tasks.hint: Ask guide to decode symbolic carvings on ancient marble columns.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about architectural motif symbolism.

tasks.goal: Discuss how archeologists dated a recently excavated Roman mosaic floor
tasks.hint: Inquire about radiocarbon dating and stratigraphy methods.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed archaeological dating methods.

tasks.goal: Ask guide for insight on controversial attribution of an unmarked sculpture
tasks.hint: Inquire which art historians attribute the work to a famous master.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sculpture attribution controversy.

tasks.goal: Inquire about museum acquisition policies regarding looted historical relics
tasks.hint: Ask guide about ethical repatriation guidelines for international artifacts.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about museum artifact acquisition ethics.

tasks.goal: Discuss the influence of Byzantine icon design on early Renaissance art
tasks.hint: Ask guide to compare religious painting styles across centuries.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed Byzantine influence on Renaissance art.

tasks.goal: Ask guide to explain structural engineering behind gothic cathedral displays
tasks.hint: Inquire about flying buttress design models shown in gallery.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cathedral structural engineering.

tasks.goal: Discuss how lighting and climate controls prevent degradation of paper manuscripts
tasks.hint: Inquire about humidity thresholds for rare book preservation.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed manuscript conservation environmental controls.

tasks.goal: Inquire about private donor benefactor support for temporary special exhibits
tasks.hint: Ask how corporate grants sponsor traveling international collections.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about exhibition sponsorship funding.

tasks.goal: Ask guide where coat check and locker storage facilities are located
tasks.hint: Inquire where to drop off heavy backpacks before starting tour.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about coat check facilities.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished marble floors echo with soft footsteps beneath vaulted stone arches.

tasks.goal: Inquire if flash photography restrictions apply to temporary loans
tasks.hint: Ask guide if taking photos with phone camera light is prohibited.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about flash photography rules.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft overhead spotlights illuminate a glass vitrine housing a gold crown.

tasks.goal: Ask guide to speak louder near noisy fountain installations
tasks.hint: Politely request increased speaking volume in acoustics room.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked guide to increase speaking volume.
tasks.scene_hint: Water sparkles in an indoor atrium fountain surrounded by stone statues.

tasks.goal: Inquire if audio headsets offer descriptive commentary for visually impaired guests
tasks.hint: Ask about accessibility features of museum audio guides.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about audio guide accessibility options.
tasks.scene_hint: Headset cables hang neatly beside numbered digital audio player docks.

tasks.goal: Ask guide if resting benches are situated inside upcoming sculpture rooms
tasks.hint: Inquire where visitors can sit during long walkthroughs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about resting benches in galleries.
tasks.scene_hint: Wooden bench seating sits centered before a colossal marble sculpture.

tasks.goal: Inquire about museum library access for independent historical research
tasks.hint: Ask guide if public visitors may view reference archives.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about museum research library access.
tasks.scene_hint: Glass doors reveal rows of leather-bound archival folios in the library.

tasks.goal: Ask guide how to locate emergency exit doors in sub-gallery levels
tasks.hint: Inquire about emergency egress routes in underground halls.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gallery emergency exit locations.
tasks.scene_hint: Illuminated green exit signage glows above heavy bronze double doors.

tasks.goal: Inquire if museum cafe serves hot meals during afternoon hours
tasks.hint: Ask guide where to get lunch inside the building.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about museum cafe dining hours.
tasks.scene_hint: Aroma of roasted espresso drifts from the glass-walled courtyard cafe.

tasks.goal: Ask guide if sketchpads and pencils are allowed in drawing galleries
tasks.hint: Inquire about rules for art students sketching exhibits.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pencil sketching in galleries.
tasks.scene_hint: An art student holding a charcoal pad sits quietly on a folding stool.

tasks.goal: Inquire about children's interactive scavenger hunt worksheets at information desk
tasks.hint: Ask guide if educational activities exist for young visitors.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about children's museum educational materials.
tasks.scene_hint: Colorful printed map booklets sit in acrylic holders at the information counter.

tasks.goal: Ask guide if museum gift store stocks catalog books for this exhibition
tasks.hint: Inquire where to buy official hardcover exhibition prints.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gift store exhibition catalog books.
tasks.scene_hint: Glossy art catalogs rest on polished wood display tables near the exit.

tasks.goal: Respond when guide asks group to move closer to display case
tasks.hint: Step forward to allow trailing visitors room to see.
tasks.done_when: Learner responded to guide's request to move closer.

tasks.goal: Clarify historical date mentioned by guide during gallery presentation
tasks.hint: Ask guide to re-state century or era details.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked guide to clarify historical date.

tasks.goal: Address guide warning regarding standing too close to unshielded oil painting
tasks.hint: Step back behind velvet barrier ropes.
tasks.done_when: Learner stepped back behind safety barrier.

tasks.goal: Politely ask guide to repeat explanation of ancient hieroglyphic translation
tasks.hint: Request guide re-explain Rosetta stone decoding steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked guide to repeat hieroglyphic explanation.

tasks.goal: Respond to guide query asking if visitors have questions about armor suit construction
tasks.hint: Inquire about metal weight and suit flexibility.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked question about armor construction.

tasks.goal: Address situation when tour group gets delayed in security doorway
tasks.hint: Wait patiently while security clears group movement.
tasks.done_when: Learner waited for group clearance through doorway.

tasks.goal: Clarify guide statement regarding original ownership of royal jewelry
tasks.hint: Inquire which dynasty possessed the displayed gemstones.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for clarification on gemstone ownership.

tasks.goal: Respond when guide points out subtle brushwork technique on Impressionist canvas
tasks.hint: Examine canvas texture and comment on paint thickness.
tasks.done_when: Learner examined canvas texture following guide comment.

tasks.goal: Address guide inquiry on whether anyone needs a brief rest break
tasks.hint: State preference for taking a five-minute water break.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed preference for brief rest break.

tasks.goal: Clarify guide explanation of pottery firing techniques in ancient Greece
tasks.hint: Ask if terra cotta kilns used wood or charcoal fuel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ancient pottery kiln fuel.

tasks.goal: Respond when guide asks for opinions on modern abstract installation
tasks.hint: Express personal interpretation of industrial materials used.
tasks.done_when: Learner shared interpretation of modern art piece.

tasks.goal: Address guide notice that next gallery wing has lower temperature controls
tasks.hint: Put on light jacket before entering climate controlled hall.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged gallery climate control adjustment.

tasks.goal: Clarify guide instructions for returning rented audio guide devices at exit
tasks.hint: Confirm drop-off bin location near main lobby turnstiles.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed audio device return instructions.

tasks.goal: Confirm return time for guided tour after brief restroom break
tasks.hint: Ask guide when group resumes walk.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed tour resumption time after break.

tasks.goal: Ask guide if membership pass includes free entry to guest lecture series
tasks.hint: Inquire about member perks for evening talks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about member benefits for lectures.

tasks.goal: Inquire if museum allows re-entry on same day ticket stub
tasks.hint: Ask if hand stamp permits leaving for lunch and returning.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about same-day museum re-entry policy.

tasks.goal: Request guide recommendation for must-see gallery rooms after tour concludes
tasks.hint: Ask which hall to explore independently.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for independent gallery recommendations.

tasks.goal: Ask guide if photography for academic publication requires special permit
tasks.hint: Inquire about commercial image licensing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about academic photography permits.

tasks.goal: Confirm elevator capacity for large tour group moving between floors
tasks.hint: Ask if group should split between two elevators.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed elevator group split procedure.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal rotations of print and drawing collections
tasks.hint: Ask guide how frequently paper works are swapped.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about print collection rotation schedules.

tasks.goal: Inquire about annual museum membership subscription rates
tasks.hint: Ask guide for details on supporting member tiers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about museum annual membership pricing.

tasks.goal: Ask guide where to leave written feedback comments for tour management
tasks.hint: Inquire about visitor satisfaction survey cards.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where to leave tour feedback.

tasks.goal: Confirm museum closing bell warning schedule before final gallery exit
tasks.hint: Ask guide when security begins clearing halls.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed museum closing bell schedule.

tasks.goal: Request guide contact info for scheduling private group university visits
tasks.hint: Inquire how professors book private educational tours.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested private group tour booking contact.

tasks.goal: Ask guide how to locate main exit turnstiles from upper gallery level
tasks.hint: Inquire about direct stair route to lobby exit.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for directions to main exit turnstiles.

tasks.goal: Express appreciation to tour guide for detailed historical commentary
tasks.hint: Thank guide for engaging and informative tour.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed appreciation for tour guide commentary.

name_translations.Japanese: 美術館のガイドツアー

place_translations.Japanese: 歴史と芸術博物館のロビー
